_schema: neat-bench target descriptor v1. Consumed by harness/provision/lib.sh (jq). Underscore-prefixed keys are notes and are ignored by the loader.
_status: PLACEHOLDER — repo is REAL, but the pinned commit and every run-specific field (install/test/entrypoint/env) are UNVERIFIED in this environment. See _verified and the TODO(live) notes. Do not treat this as known-runnable until a human pins a green commit and confirms the suite drives real Redis+Postgres traffic.
description: an image/media service with a BullMQ (Redis-backed) job queue and a Postgres database
_repo_note: immich — a self-hosted photo/video service. Chosen because it is a REAL, widely-used OSS product (not a teaching boilerplate — the RUNBOOK.md trap), it is large and messy (the kind of target where NEAT's OBSERVED layer separates from static reading), and its job queue is central: the NestJS server uses BullMQ over Redis for thumbnail/transcode/ML jobs, plus a Postgres database. That async queue seam is exactly the non-local causality NEAT is meant to make visible.
_commit_note: TODO(live): PIN A KNOWN-GREEN COMMIT. This is a placeholder, not a verified SHA. Pick a tagged release commit, check it out, and confirm `install_cmd` + `traffic.test_cmd` run green against the datastores below before trusting any number. Contract: an exact 40-char SHA that `git checkout` accepts.
_subdir_note: immich is a monorepo; the instrumented + run package is the NestJS server. TODO(live): verify the server package path for your pinned commit (historically `server/`).
_node_note: TODO(live): verify against the pinned commit's server/.nvmrc / package.json engines. The daemon runs on default node; this is the Node that runs the TARGET (app + tests). Override at runtime with NODE_TARGET=/path/to/nodeXX.
_service_id_note: Becomes the graph node id `service:immich-server` and the /graph/observed-dependencies/<svc> key. TODO(live): confirm the service name NEAT extracts for this package (it derives from package.json name / dir); set this to match so observed-dependencies resolves.
_datastores_note: Generic containers, namespaced <target-id>-<name> by the provisioner. NO CONNECTORS anywhere — these are the app's real datastores that its own traffic hits, and NEAT sees them via OTel client spans only.

datastores._image_note: TODO(live): immich needs a Postgres with its vector extension, NOT stock postgres. Use immich's documented database image for the pinned commit (historically a pgvecto.rs / VectorChord image, e.g. `ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord...` or `tensorchord/pgvecto-rs`). Stock `postgres:16` will fail immich's migrations. Fill the exact image + tag your commit expects.
datastores.name: postgres

_env_note: TODO(live): verify the exact env keys immich's server reads for your pinned commit (they change across releases). These point the app at the two containers above on localhost. Written verbatim to <subdir>/.env by the provisioner.
_install_note: TODO(live): verify. Runs in <subdir> (server) by default; set install_cwd to the repo root if the pinned commit uses npm workspaces that must install from the top. Runs under node_version via a PATH shim.
_instrument_note: `node $NEAT_CLI init --apply .` runs in <subdir>, writes the otel-init preload (with NEAT's call-site span processor) + a require() in the entrypoint, and adds OTel deps (we reinstall after). Leave otel_init empty to let the provisioner discover the generated preload; set it if discovery fails.
_entrypoint_note: TODO(live): OPTIONAL. Only needed if a wall requires the LIVE app for HTTP probes; default traffic is the test suite, which does not need the app running. Verify immich's built entrypoint + start command + ping route for your commit.
_traffic_note: DELIBERATE: traffic = the target's OWN test suite (span-driven), preloaded with otel-init via NODE_OPTIONS so runner-spawned processes emit spans to the scoped daemon. NO bespoke HTTP driver, NO connectors.

traffic._test_cmd_note: TODO(live): CRITICAL — this MUST be the suite that exercises REAL Redis + Postgres (so BullMQ enqueue/process + DB query spans actually fire), NOT the mocked unit tests (which mock ioredis/the repo layer and produce ZERO OBSERVED edges). For immich, candidates are the medium/integration tests (historically `npm run test:medium`) or the `e2e/` package. Verify which script hits the live containers above and set it here.
traffic._probes_note: OPTIONAL per-wall HTTP supplements for a wall path the suite misses. Requires start_cmd/app up. Each: {method, path, port?, body?, headers{}}.
